report_name: 'City-Forum' Campaign Steals Data from Misconfigured SaaS Portals

threat_actors.name: City-Forum
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated threat actor, active since at least March 2025, responsible for the 'City-Forum' data theft campaign. The actor targets misconfigured Salesforce and ServiceNow portals using a custom toolset to scrape and exfiltrate sensitive data accessible to unauthenticated guest users, and has developed novel techniques for attacking Salesforce LWR sites.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The City-Forum actor systematically scrapes and exfiltrates data from misconfigured Salesforce Experience Cloud and ServiceNow portals, which are cloud-based storage and application platforms.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The campaign exploits customer-side misconfigurations in public-facing Salesforce and ServiceNow portals that allow unauthenticated guest users to access sensitive data.

attack_patterns.name: Create Account: Cloud Account
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor searches for misconfigured self-registration endpoints on SaaS portals, which could be abused to create an authenticated cloud account with elevated access privileges.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The attacker systematically probes public-facing SaaS portals to discover misconfigurations and data exposed via frameworks like Salesforce Aura and the ServiceNow search API.

tools.name: City-Forum Custom Scraper
tools.description: A custom toolset used by the City-Forum actor to systematically enumerate and exfiltrate data from misconfigured Salesforce (Aura and LWR) and ServiceNow portals. It includes a novel capability to send GraphQL requests directly to the Salesforce LWR UI API.

campaigns.name: City-Forum Campaign
campaigns.description: An ongoing data theft campaign, active since at least March 2025, that targets misconfigured Salesforce and ServiceNow portals worldwide to scrape and exfiltrate data accessible to unauthenticated guest users.

infrastructure.name: City-Forum Attacker Server
infrastructure.description: A single server hosted by Contabo in Germany, identified by IP 158.220.87.79, used for all attack activities in the City-Forum campaign.

indicators.name: Anomalous Salesforce Guest User API Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Salesforce Guest User API Activity
id: 4a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of requests from a single unauthenticated source to Salesforce API endpoints, potentially indicating data scraping by the City-Forum campaign.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/city-forum-data-theft-attacks-target-salesforce-servicenow-portals/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/s/sfsites/aura'
      - '/s/sfsites/lwc'
      - '/graphql'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects high-volume access to Salesforce Aura, LWC, or GraphQL API endpoints from unauthenticated guest users, a TTP of the City-Forum campaign.
